title: identity.rs: unwrap_or("") after email validation is dead code
description: After email_present validation (which continues on fail), the handler does obj_val["email"].as_str().unwrap_or(""). The unwrap_or("") arm is unreachable: validation already ensured email is present and non-empty. Reads as if empty string is possible when it cannot be. Fix: extract the &str in the validation block, or use .expect("validated above"). As-is, a contributor who removes the validation check would silently create an identity with empty email.
